integrity: An explicit incidence-matrix proof and executable exact small-order verifier are supplied. Self-review C/O/V passed; no independent audit or external validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to line graphs of complete graphs with a matching deleted and n>=4. It does not prove graph determination by spectrum; the polynomial is computed with explicit boundary cancellation. Earlier equivalent formulations under other nomenclature may exist; finite exact checks are not all-order proofs.
title: Laplacian spectrum and integral-spectrum boundary for line graphs of matching-deleted cliques
